snippet.title: SILENT HILL f | Accolades Trailer (4K:EN/ESRB) | KONAMI
snippet.description:
With over a million copies sold worldwide*, we've been truly thrilled at the love and support that SILENT HILL f has received from fans and critics alike. 
See some of the praise that the game is enjoying from news outlets around the world in this latest trailer.

Will Hinako choose to embrace elegance and beauty?
Or will her path lead her to madness and horror...

There's never been a better time to experience this story of impossible decisions. 
Find the beauty in terror, and terror from beauty.

*Combined global sales figure is per internal tracking, as of Sept 26, 2025. Includes both digital and package sales.
